## 2026-09-20 — "The bump I'd already met"

A thin day with one real thread. `self-evolving/lean-workspace-template` entered the sweep for the first time, and its only signals were two open Dependabot PRs carrying the exact grouped-majors bump the garden's `shared ancestry means shared exposure` note predicted would surface across every Quartz-descended repo:

- [#35](https://github.com/self-evolving/lean-workspace-template/pull/35) — 33-package production group (js-yaml 4→5, toml 3→5, sharp 0.34→0.35, satori 0.19→0.29, and more)
- [#1](https://github.com/self-evolving/lean-workspace-template/pull/1) — CI sextet (checkout 4→7, github-script 7→9, upload/download-artifact, setup-node, create-pull-request)

The entry reads #1 — the repo's first PR, still open and rebased today — as `a deferred bump compounds` made literal, and links `a rebase resets the wrong clock`. No new idea planted; two existing seedling/budding notes reinforced. Issue #504 (in-window but fully covered by the 2026-09-19 entry) was deliberately not re-reported.

### Signals
- 2 source PRs (both `lean-workspace-template`, Dependabot)
- 1 source issue (#504 — already covered yesterday)
- 0 releases, 0 discussions, 0 diary issues, 0 failed sources

### Files
- `content/diary/2026-09-20.md` (new)
- `content/diary/_meta.json` (newest-first)

### Validation
`npm run check` surfaces only pre-existing TS errors from uninstalled `node_modules` (unrelated to content); edited `_meta.json` verified as valid JSON and all wikilinks resolve to existing notes.

The single review is a clean SHIP with only INFO notes and an explicit `no_action` on inline comments, so no inline comments are warranted. Here is the synthesis.

## Summary of PR/Issue
This PR adds one new diary entry (`content/diary/2026-09-20.md`, 54 lines) and prepends `2026-09-20` to `content/diary/_meta.json`. The entry narrates `self-evolving/lean-workspace-template` entering the sweep for the first time, reading its two open Dependabot PRs (#35's 33-package production group and #1's CI sextet) as a literal confirmation of the garden's existing `shared ancestry means shared exposure` note. It reinforces three existing seedling/budding ideas rather than planting a new one, and deliberately does not re-report issue #504 (covered on 2026-09-19). The change is content-only and confined to `content/diary/`, consistent with the AGENTS.md rule that diary automation writes only under `content/`.

## Review
Exemplary content PR: every specific, checkable fact was independently verified against the live source repository, the entry follows diary schema/voice/linking conventions, and scope is cleanly limited to two content files. No blocking or warning-level issues were found; all remaining notes are informational and non-actionable.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| No actionable issues | INFO | All package-version, PR-timing, and ancestry claims verified against the live source; frontmatter, manifest, wikilinks, and continuity all check out. |
| Hedged inference on #1's history | INFO | The `checkout` "didn't open at 4→7" claim is appropriately hedged and corroborated by #1's upstream changelog; no change needed. |
| Reinforced ideas' `tended:` dates untouched | INFO | Correct per the garden skill — `tended:` bumps belong to tending passes, not diary-record runs. |
| `a-deferred-bump-compounds` promotion candidate | INFO | Repeatedly reinforced seedling that looks ready for `seedling → budding`, but that is a future tending pass, out of scope here. |

## Progress
- Editorial choices are explained in the PR body and endorsed by the reviewer: reinforcing three existing ideas instead of planting a redundant one, and not re-reporting #504 (already covered 2026-09-19).
- Reviewer independently verified all factual claims (package majors, PR numbers/timestamps, "first PR opened when the workspace was cut") against the public source repo; all passed.
- Manifest verified valid JSON, newest-first, no duplicates; the three idea wikilink targets confirmed to exist and resolve.
- `npm run check`/`build` was not run in the review or PR environment (`node_modules` not installed); given two small content files, direct inspection is sufficient.
- No existing inline comments or review threads on the PR; no inline comments posted in this synthesis (nothing line-specific to flag).

## Recommended Next Step
`NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` — the single review returns SHIP with only non-actionable INFO notes; no branch change is required, and the one forward-looking suggestion (idea promotion) belongs to a separate tending pass.

## Final Verdict
`SHIP`

## Action Items
- [ ] None — no required branch changes. (Optional, out of scope: consider promoting `a-deferred-bump-compounds` from `seedling` to `budding` in a future tending pass.)
